subject: Hyperbolic Agent kickoff - multi-horizon value learning
body:
Team,

Kicking off the Hyperbolic Agent effort for agents-rl. Basis is our open-source release on hyperbolic discounting and learning over multiple horizons: instead of one exponential discount, the agent maintains value heads across many gammas and combines them hyperbolically. The interesting product question isn't the discounting itself - it's the repeated finding that the multi-horizon auxiliary task makes the base agent stronger, especially on exploration-heavy games.

Scope: reproduce Hyperbolic/Multi-Rainbow from the shipped gin configs, then sweep the head count and exponent to find the cheapest configuration that keeps the gains. Milestones: repro by early April, sweep through May, recommendation memo by 2026-06-15 feeding the Q3 agent-training-stack decisions.

Halima leads experiments, Leilani infra, Gustavo analysis. Bao - staffing and compute note please, the Atari sweeps are the cost center here.

Ulla
